meta.title: Split with everything in one lot

steps.note: Create the buyer-side event needed to reach lot management.
Use an RFQ event, which is the pricing event being split into lots.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Create multiple line items so the lot assignment can be tested.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line items.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add the required QA test vendor participant.
Publish the event so its lot-management screen is available.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.

args.goal: open the published event's lot or split-event management drawer, assign every line item to Lot 1 so no item is assigned to a second lot, save the lot plan, and stop on the screen showing the refusal that line items must be assigned to at least two lots

steps.note: Perform the unsupported lot assignment and save action in the buyer session.

args.text: Please assign line item to at least two lots

steps.note: Assert the exact expected refusal message.
